<thought>To propose a one‑step synthesis, I will look for a retrosynthetic template that forms a C=C bond by a Wittig reaction, which typically breaks a carbonyl (C=O) and forms a C=C. I will search the template catalog for such a transformation.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "C=C(C1=CC=C(OC)C=C1)C2=CC=C(OC)C=C2",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["C=O"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["C=C"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
